description: ## Side projects I am working on
- A Personal daily drive distro based on debian linux
- Setting up auto updated/maintained/secure cloud solutions for replacing Big Tech products on daily life
photo-video/contact storing, password managing, note taking and calendar.
- An education platform for teachers and middle/high school students
'Portal' for managing classes like homeworks, quizes, exams, live classes, conferences, grading, auto analysis of students.
'Shelf' for teachers to share free/paid lessons, and for students to buy, watch lessons, follow classes.
- Obviously LLMs and how to use them efficiently
- Building practical solutions for daily life problems
- Engineering a communication protocol immune to intervention
- Building a solution for distinguishing true and false news/information from social media
